sources.supported_scope: false documents detected by Border Police at Lamezia Terme airport during attempted boarding for a London Stansted flight

supported_facts: The occurrence is documented at Lamezia Terme airport during passenger boarding controls.
The official source describes two travellers found in possession of false identity/travel documents while attempting to board a flight to London Stansted.
The arrest is contemporaneous with the document-control occurrence rather than an unrelated later procedural location.

event_identity_analysis.rationale: One continuous airport-control occurrence involving the same control point and same attempted journey is described. Multiple persons/documents do not require multiple EVENT IDs.

temporal_analysis.source_wording: Friday previous to the 16 March 2020 release
temporal_analysis.caution: Retain the derivation basis; do not present the derived calendar date as a verbatim source field.

offence_analysis.reported_family: possession/use of false identity or travel documents

recommended_resolution: Individually resolvable discrete EVENT candidate at an exact public site. Eligible for reviewed-bundle preparation after human review of the calendar-derived occurrence date and offence crosswalk.
publication_blockers: Human review must confirm the calendar-derived occurrence date and public text before approved reviewed-bundle status.
